mechanism: Febuxostat is metabolized by CYP2C8 and CYP1A2, while amoxicillin-clavulanate may cause mild renal function changes affecting febuxostat clearance, and both drugs can rarely cause hyperuricemia complications or rash.
action: Monitor renal function periodically and watch for adverse effects; no dose adjustment typically required but counsel patient on signs of gout flare or rash exacerbation.
